title: Pipeline Time Economy: where time and tokens actually go
summary: A whole-pipeline time and cost analysis over 847 tasks: compute vs. waiting vs. redo, the retry tax and its causes, and why tokens dwarf compute. Separates hard evidence from derived interpretation.
statusReason: The 847-task measurement is complete and its evidence cards AGT-2293 and AGT-2200 are archived.
